profile.name: Sai Sri Harsha Guddati
profile.summary: Infrastructure Platform Engineer IV at UF IT, maintaining a LiteLLM gateway on a shared 9B+ tokens/day platform and building FastAPI services, Celery/Redis streaming workflows, and retrieval systems.

impact.label: Shared AI platform behind the LiteLLM gateway I maintain and extend
Real-time token delivery across 12+ generative AI workflows
Production services deployed and operated on Kubernetes

projects.name: IntentGuard
projects.title: IntentGuard
projects.description: A Python command-review CLI combining shell rules, classifier risk, BM25-ranked command history, and LiteLLM into allow, warn, or block decisions.

projects.name: WebLMS
projects.title: WebLMS
projects.description: A TypeScript extension that extracts DOM text and tables, runs Tesseract.js OCR, caches page context in IndexedDB, and answers with extractive sentence scoring.

projects.name: RAG Agent
projects.title: RAG Agent
projects.description: A Streamlit assistant with 1,000-character document chunks, MiniLM embeddings, persistent Chroma cosine search, selected-document retrieval, and optional web-search augmentation.

projects.name: AppTrack
projects.title: AppTrack
projects.description: Go HTTP/UDP collectors accept structured SDK events, publish to Kafka, and feed a ClickHouse consumer for column-oriented event analytics.

projects.name: Vision AI
projects.title: Vision AI
projects.description: A FastAPI and Next.js prototype combining layered PDF extraction, OCR fallback, local MiniLM embeddings, NumPy cosine retrieval, and source-aware document chat.

projects.name: NavigatorPrompt
projects.title: NavigatorPrompt
projects.description: A Next.js prompt workspace with FastAPI task endpoints, Celery generation/evaluation workers, Redis result handling, and PostgreSQL-backed prompt history and libraries.

projects.name: Incident PDF Ingestor
projects.title: Realtime Incident Processor
projects.description: Downloads public incident PDFs, reconstructs wrapped records with PyPDF2 and regular expressions, inserts normalized SQLite rows, and reports grouped incident counts.

projects.name: Incident Visualizer
projects.title: Incident Visualizer
projects.description: A Flask interface that reads incident records with pandas, geocodes addresses, clusters coordinates with KMeans, and renders Matplotlib/Seaborn chart artifacts.

projects.name: FBI Data Pipeline
projects.title: FBI Data Pipeline
projects.description: A Python CLI that reads FBI Wanted API pages or local JSON, normalizes multi-value fields, and emits a documented three-field delimited format.

projects.name: Resume Ranker
projects.title: SOTA ATS Resume
projects.description: A Flask NLP workflow combining resume extraction, SentenceTransformer embeddings, TF-IDF similarity, and structured skills to rank resumes against job descriptions.

projects.name: Redacted Name Predictor
projects.title: ML Redaction Engine
projects.description: An NLP experiment using redaction length, neighboring words, POS tags, and n-grams with CountVectorizer and class-balanced logistic regression to reconstruct names.

projects.name: University Job Scraper
projects.title: Distributed Data Scraper
projects.description: A Requests/BeautifulSoup script that pairs UF job-listing rows with summaries, normalizes listing fields, and composes an SMTP email report.

projects.name: WebChat
projects.title: WebChat
projects.description: React and Dexie/IndexedDB track pending messages; authenticated FastAPI WebSockets deliver room events, while a sync API reconciles offline records and server IDs.

projects.name: Personal Website Backend
projects.title: Personal Website Backend
projects.description: The original FastAPI service for this portfolio’s projects, journal entries, and contact workflows. The website now uses repository-managed JSON content.

projects.name: GeoGuard
projects.title: GeoGuard
projects.description: Clusters location history with DBSCAN, identifies frequently visited places, perturbs sensitive coordinates, and integrates with a browser geolocation override.

projects.name: Compiler Design
projects.title: Compiler Design
projects.description: A Delphi/Pascal grammar and Java parse-tree visitor with nested scope maps, class definitions, object fields, and method metadata.

experiences.description: I maintain and extend UFIT’s LiteLLM-based gateway on a shared platform processing 9B+ tokens per day, and build the products and services connected to it.

highlights.title: A gateway for shared AI access
highlights.text: Provider routing and failover, API-key authentication, RBAC, team isolation, budgets, and audit logging for multi-tenant LLM access.
highlights.label: 9B+ tokens / day on the shared platform
implementation: Control plane: API keys, RBAC, team isolation, budgets, and audit records.
Provider path: request routing and failover across model providers.

highlights.title: NaviGator Prompt Builder
highlights.text: Led development across Next.js, TypeScript, and FastAPI, connecting prompt creation, evaluation, and sharing to backend AI services.
highlights.label: Product + platform ownership
implementation: Product layer: Next.js and TypeScript prompt-creation, evaluation, and sharing flows.
Service layer: FastAPI endpoints connected to backend AI services.

highlights.title: Real-time delivery
highlights.text: Redesigned streaming with Redis Pub/Sub, Celery, and Server-Sent Events for 2,000+ concurrent token streams across 12+ generative AI workflows.
highlights.label: 2,000+ concurrent streams
implementation: Execution: Celery background workers and Redis Pub/Sub event delivery.
Client transport: Server-Sent Events for 2,000+ concurrent token streams across 12+ workflows.

highlights.title: Grounded answers and evaluation
highlights.text: Built OCR, chunking, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and source-attributed document pipelines, with regression harnesses for groundedness, tool calls, schema compliance, and provider failures.
highlights.label: Retrieval + evaluation
implementation: Ingestion: OCR fallback, chunking, embeddings, and metadata filters.
Retrieval: lexical + dense candidates, reranking, and source attribution.
Regression checks: relevance, groundedness, tool-call correctness, JSON schema, latency, and provider failures.

highlights.title: A departmental Data Science Agent
highlights.text: Combined TimesFM forecasting, BM25, and dense retrieval over PostgreSQL/pgvector to work with Excel and PDF datasets containing hundreds of thousands of rows.
highlights.label: Data + reasoning
implementation: Data sources: Excel and PDF datasets with hundreds of thousands of rows.
Query path: BM25 + dense retrieval over PostgreSQL/pgvector.
Analysis path: TimesFM forecasting alongside document and tabular workflows.

highlights.title: Operating the platform
highlights.text: Deploy and operate 10+ Kubernetes microservices with Terraform, F5 load balancing, GitLab CI/CD, health checks, automated tests, and staged rollouts.
highlights.label: 10+ production microservices
implementation: Infrastructure: Kubernetes workloads, Terraform, and F5 load balancing.
Release path: GitLab CI/CD, automated tests, health checks, and staged rollouts.

experiences.description: Built Java Spring Boot and Node.js services supporting 100K+ daily user interactions, with stable APIs and SQL-backed workflows across business units.

highlights.title: APIs that teams can build on
highlights.text: Request validation, idempotent processing, and backward-compatible REST contracts for independently deployed frontends and downstream systems.
highlights.label: 100K+ daily interactions
implementation: Service interfaces: Java Spring Boot and Node.js REST APIs.
Contract handling: validation, idempotent processing, and backward compatibility.

highlights.title: Data performance
highlights.text: Tuned PostgreSQL and MSSQL query plans, joins, indexes, and connection usage, reducing average API response time by approximately 50%.
highlights.label: SQL + service optimization
implementation: Database layer: PostgreSQL and MSSQL query plans, joins, indexes, and connection usage.
Reported result: approximately 50% lower average API response time.

highlights.title: Asynchronous work and repeatable releases
highlights.text: Moved high-volume ingestion into workers with retries and rate limits, and maintained GitLab CI/CD pipelines for testing, packaging, and multi-environment deployment.
highlights.label: Workers + CI/CD
implementation: Worker path: asynchronous ingestion with retries and rate limits.
Release path: GitLab CI/CD for tests, packaging, and environment deployment.

platformSystems.title: Shared AI gateway
platformSystems.detail: API-key authentication, RBAC and team isolation define access. Provider routing and failover, team budgets, and audit logging keep shared usage accountable.

platformSystems.title: Concurrent token streaming
platformSystems.detail: Background execution and event delivery are separate from the browser-facing stream. My work redesigned this path for concurrent token delivery across generative AI workflows.

platformSystems.title: Retrieval and evaluation
platformSystems.detail: Document extraction and metadata-filtered retrieval feed answers with source attribution. Evaluation checks relevance, groundedness, tool calls, schema conformance, latency, and provider failures.
